signatures.reason: Docker Official Images publish no Sigstore or Notation signatures (docker/roadmap#562 is still open), so trust rests on digest pinning, docker-library provenance and a current vulnerability scan. Revisit when upstream signs or when images move to a signed source such as Docker Hardened Images.

acceptedLanguageRisks.reason: Dependencies bundled inside the npm CLI that ships with the Node image. The services run node directly; npm only runs during image builds.
Go standard library findings in gosu, which docker-library builds with an older Go toolchain. gosu only drops privileges once at container start and handles no network or user input.
